Overview

The build earns trust the same way every gate does: models, agents and rules move through versioned, evaluated releases across the Healthcare & Life Sciences estate, and rollback is rehearsed before go-live rather than after the incident. Healthcare & Life Sciences punishes generic deployments. clinical reality moves faster than batch cycles, HIPAA / HITECH demands evidence chains most tools cannot produce, and the estate is heterogeneous — which is why every engagement starts with the seams named above rather than a platform-first rollout.
